name: agent-workflow-skills-only
description: Discover and install the local-first Agent Workflow plugin for Codex projects without connecting to a hosted Agent Workflow service.

interface.longDescription: Learn how to install and use the self-contained, local-first Agent Workflow plugin in Codex. This directory edition provides onboarding guidance only: it does not connect to a hosted Agent Workflow service and does not expose MCP tools in ChatGPT. The full GitHub edition downloads a pinned runtime and runs it locally so projects, commands, approvals, receipts, and Agent Workflow Studio remain on the user's machine.
defaultPrompt: Help me install Agent Workflow locally in Codex.
Explain how Agent Workflow keeps project automation local.
Check whether this Codex project is ready for Agent Workflow.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only directory edition for discovering, installing, and safely onboarding the self-contained local Agent Workflow plugin.
